Diagnose fold-training support for held-out local cases

Source: R/csdg_local_fidelity_audit.R
csdg_local_support.Rd

Measures the proximity of each requested held-out case to the analysis rows for its corresponding fold model. Missing case values are filled from that fold-training background before distances are calculated.

Usage

csdg_local_support(
  x,
  cases,
  kernel_width = 0.75,
  case_labels = NULL,
  case_metadata = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A CSDGResample with stored fold models.

cases

Unique task row ids that each occur in exactly one assessment split.

kernel_width

Positive kernel width used for the within-kernel proportion and Kish effective sample size.

case_labels

Optional unique pseudonymous labels in the same order as cases.

case_metadata

Optional data frame with one row per case and columns, such as a prespecified risk stratum, that are copied to the output.

Value

A data table with held-out split identifiers, optional case metadata, case-imputation details, nearest-neighbor distances, the proportion of fold-training rows within the kernel, kernel-weight Kish effective sample size, and the fold-training background size.

Examples

set.seed(1L)
example_x1 = rnorm(60L)
example_data = data.frame(
  x1 = example_x1,
  x2 = rnorm(60L),
  y = factor(ifelse(example_x1 > 0, "yes", "no"))
)
example_task = mlr3::as_task_classif(example_data, target = "y", positive = "yes")
example_learner = mlr3::lrn("classif.rpart", predict_type = "prob")
example_oof = csdg_resample(
  example_task,
  example_learner,
  mlr3::rsmp("cv", folds = 3L),
  store_models = TRUE,
  seed = 1L
)
csdg_local_support(example_oof, cases = example_oof$test_sets[[1L]][[1L]])
